pilot3: Review generation over a full experiment record, then a deterministic claim audit (the generate-verify loop of the proposed layer)
record: Schnell et al. 2025 kidney organoids (GSE264217): DESeq2 summary counts, top genes by |log2FC| among DEGs (Ensembl IDs only, no symbol mapping), top Hallmark/Reactome pathways from fgsea_results.csv. All values computed from the source tables by build_record.py.
taskA_free_draft: The model writes a structured review (<=200 words) from the record alone.
taskB_slot_filled: The platform fills every number and direction from the record into a fixed skeleton; the model writes only a 2-3 sentence interpretation and is instructed to introduce no new numbers or entities.
audit: Deterministic, in code: every number in the text must match a record value within rounding; every named pathway/gene direction must match the table sign; any 'significant' claim must satisfy the pre-registered rules; in task B, any number or entity not present in the record counts as an introduced claim.
model: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct GGUF Q4_K_M, llama.cpp, local CPU, temperature 0
